# Givens Fire and Forestry

> Wildfire mitigation, hazardous tree removal, defensible space consulting, and forestry services based in Three Forks, Montana. Led by wildland firefighter Samuel Givens.

## Official site

- https://www.givensfireandforestry.com/
- Phone: (406) 539-4224
- Montana service area: Gallatin Valley, Three Forks, Southwest Montana

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.givensfireandforestry.com/): Wildfire mitigation and fire-smart property services
- [Services](https://www.givensfireandforestry.com/services): Defensible space, hazardous tree removal, slash piles, brush, storm cleanup, post-burn cleanup
- [Tree Removal Pricing](https://www.givensfireandforestry.com/flat-rates-for-tree-removal): Flat-rate residential tree removal tiers
- [Contact / Appointments](https://www.givensfireandforestry.com/contact): Schedule a consultation (Jobber booking)
- [Appointments](https://www.givensfireandforestry.com/appointments): Book a consultation (Squarespace URL parity)
- [Resources](https://www.givensfireandforestry.com/resources): Wildfire and forest management educational links
- [Toolbox](https://www.givensfireandforestry.com/toolbox): Free tree height, firewood cord, wildfire risk, and plant identifier tools

## Free tools

- [Tree Height Calculator](https://www.givensfireandforestry.com/tree-height-calculator): Five measurement methods, metric and imperial
- [Firewood Cord Calculator](https://www.givensfireandforestry.com/firewood-cord-calculator): Volume and cord estimates for felled timber
- [Wildfire Risk Calculator](https://www.givensfireandforestry.com/wildfire-risk-calculator): Address-based LANDFIRE fuel, weather, and Rothermel risk score
- [Plant & Tree Identifier](https://www.givensfireandforestry.com/plant-identifier): Photo-based species ID with Montana fire-risk notes

## Services offered

- Defensible space / fire-smart home consultations
- Hazardous tree removal
- Slash pile removal
- Brush removal and fuel reduction
- Storm damage tree removal
- Post-burn cleanup
- Flat-rate residential tree removal (Montana)
